findings: Assignments may use rubrics for grading or only as advice; do not infer true from a present rubric.
Criteria carry their own points, optional range/scoring flags and ordered ratings; rating and description data can be nullable.
The assignment serializer separately emits rubric_settings.hide_score_total and hide_points, rubric total and free_form_criterion_comments.
The serializer may include outcome_id and vendor_guid; copying those canonical values does not infer grading requirements.
This review checks JSON data preservation and explicit optional-data diagnostics; it does not mandate score redaction or a separate rubric renderer.
